title: How to handle non-stock (service) items in subcontracting receipts?

posts.cooked:
We are using the subcontracting feature with multiple vendors, each providing different services. To model this, I created service items as non-stock items and built the BOMs accordingly. The BOMs explode correctly in the Production Plan.

However, since the Purchase Order does not automatically include the respective service item, I added a script to insert the correct service item for each vendor. This works as expected in the PO, but when creating a Subcontracting Receipt, I’m unable to proceed because the receipt also includes the service item (which is non-stock).

Has anyone faced a similar situation or found a good way to handle service items in subcontracting receipts?

Hi @developer_7

Generally, ONLY services are charged against stock items for a process outside company to a subcontractor. And stock items are expected at the time of subcontracting receipt to be returned with services cost distributed on them for valuation purpose.

No other service item is handled or expected in subcontracting run.
